title: The 5 BEST Chrome Extensions for Your Job Search
description:
No one wants to spend more time job searching than they *have* to. One of the best ways to supercharge your job search process: using Chrome extensions to maximize your productivity. Here are five of the best Chrome extensions for your job search, as rounded up by Teal founder & CEO Dave Fano.

09:14 Pocket: Save & organize company research & industry news in one place
